### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one genomeqc run (quast/, busco/, tidk/, agat/, orthofinder/, decontamination/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): assembly name in a column named sample (or in the first column), one column per factor such as a family or a clade. Joined into the genome hub: enables the design filters, the group colours and the group splits. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table assembly-name column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and filter genomes by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### Data collections

25 data collections — <span class="gtd-badge gtd-req">5 required</span> <span class="gtd-badge gtd-opt">20 optional</span> · <span class="gtd-badge gtd-direct">18 direct</span> <span class="gtd-badge gtd-derived">7 derived</span>.

**Origin** tells you whether a collection is *real pipeline data* or a reshape of it: <span class="gtd-badge gtd-direct">direct</span> = a pipeline output (scanned, or a recipe that reads raw files); <span class="gtd-badge gtd-derived">derived</span> = a recipe that reshapes one or more *direct* collections into the layout a visualization needs (no new measurement). **Reads** shows what produces it: a <span class="gtd-badge gtd-recipe">recipe</span> `.py` transform, or a raw <span class="gtd-badge gtd-file">file</span> scanned off disk. ### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (24 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`agat/gene_models.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/agat/gene_models.py) | The gene models of each annotation, one row per assembly and feature type. | `genome`, `feature_type`, `genes`, `transcripts`, `transcripts_per_gene`, `exons`, `exons_per_transcript`, `single_exon_genes`, `single_exon_gene_pct`, `overlapping_genes`, `mean_gene_length`, `median_gene_length`, `mean_transcript_length`, `mean_exon_length`, `mean_intron_length`, `mean_cds_length`, `total_gene_length` |
| [`agat/statistics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/agat/statistics.py) | Every number of an AGAT ``agat_sp_statistics.pl`` report, as a long table. | `genome`, `feature_type`, `isoforms`, `metric`, `value`, `metric_order` |
| [`busco/batch_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/busco/batch_summary.py) | One row per assessed assembly, from BUSCO's `batch_summary.txt`. | `assembly_id`, `input_file`, `lineage`, `busco_mode`, `complete_pct`, `single_pct`, `duplicated_pct`, `fragmented_pct`, `missing_pct`, `n_markers`, `stop_codon_pct`, `scaffold_n50`, `contig_n50`, `percent_gaps`, `n_scaffolds` |
| [`busco/composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/busco/composition.py) | BUSCO scores as four classes per assembly, for a composition bar. | `assembly_id`, `lineage`, `busco_mode`, `run_id`, `busco_class`, `rank`, `class_order`, `percent` |
| [`fcsadaptor/actions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fcsadaptor/actions.py) | Adaptor and vector calls of FCS-adaptor, from its ``*.fcs_adaptor_report.txt``. | `genome`, `seq_id`, `seq_len`, `action`, `start`, `end`, `flagged_bp`, `adaptor`, `source_type` |
| [`fcsgx/actions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fcsgx/actions.py) | Contamination calls of FCS-GX, from its ``*.fcs_gx_report.txt``. | `genome`, `seq_id`, `start`, `end`, `seq_len`, `action`, `division`, `division_group`, `contaminant_cov`, `top_taxon`, `flagged_bp` |
| [`nf-core/genomeqc/busco_karyotype.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/genomeqc/recipes/busco_karyotype.py) | Complete BUSCOs per sequence, drawn to scale: the nf-core/genomeqc karyotype. | `genome`, `busco_mode`, `sequence`, `start`, `end`, `sequence_length`, `complete_buscos`, `buscos_per_mb`, `busco_share_pct`, `sequence_rank` |
